DATEAugust 15, 2040

My Dearest,

Happy 26th monthsary, my love! Two whole years and two months, and even though there’s still a screen between us most of the time, loving you has been the easiest and best thing I've ever done. Who would have thought that a simple swipe on Tinder back then would lead me to my favorite person in the entire world?

I know I love to push your buttons and tease you just to get a reaction out of you (admittedly, my favorite extreme sport), but you already know it’s just my ultimate way of showing you how much I care and how comfortable I am with you. Thank you for always putting up with my nonsense, for laughing with me, and for being my constant source of comfort even from miles away.

I can't wait for the day we finally close the distance, but until then, I hope this little virtual box reminds you of how much you mean to me. Here’s to 26 months of us, and to so many more years and adventures to come (including that 2040 cruise!).

I love you so much, always.

— Yours

Someday soon, I'll slip this on your finger and ask you the one question my heart already knows the answer to. Until then, know that I choose you today, tomorrow, and for every day after. Forever yours.
